scope: Task4 only: three-style generation diagnostics, one prespecified shrinkage copula, current raw Q1 fingerprints, complete finite-grid migration checks and fixed historical path refit sensitivity. Not task5 repeated nested validation or brewing confirmation.
copula: Per-style midrank normal scores, LedoitWolf covariance shrinkage rescaled to a correlation matrix, independent Gaussian draws and empirical inverse marginal interpolation. Fit imputation and all marginal/covariance parameters on current unique training beers only. Bounded empirical support is a modeling assumption, not known physical support.
generation_replacement: Replace interpolation only if copula mean held-out marginal W1 and energy are both no higher, each style mean energy no more than 10% worse, each style held-out coverage drop <=0.05, mean variance ratio in [0.8,1.2], mean rank-correlation RMSE <= interpolation+0.05, exact training-copy rate no higher, and mean model-consistent raw-median sensory W1 <= interpolation+0.02. Otherwise retain interpolation and its diagnosed weaknesses. No post-result retuning.
sensory_validation: Use matching R2b outer-training point/risk models for generated and held-out real spectra. Compare generated predicted raw medians with both held-out model medians and observed balanced raw medians; compare raw ET rating distributions separately. These are generator-plus-predictor diagnostics, not measurements of generated beer.
migration_pool: Only the 8293 frozen historically eligible paths from review_path_tradeoff_20261025, reconstructed from fixed before spectra and resolution anchors. Retain historical eligibility as provenance; no enlargement of anchors or grid. Freshly check ranges, both style classifiers, four coordinate caps and current raw constraints. Old continuous-Stale eligibility is reused, not independently refitted for every grid point.
current_raw_constraints: For all five defects require current integer raw grade nonincrease AND nonincrease of rating>=1, rating>=5 and rating=6 probabilities, both calibrated and selected-uncalibrated. Probability guards are scenarios, not calibrated intervention bounds. Preserve two unlabelled acetaldehyde fields as blank.
coordinate_policy: Source caps are frozen observed coordinates or explicitly conditional attachment8 Diacetyl zero bounds for missing values. Do not substitute imputed medians as measurement caps or require defects to reach Tripel empirical lower bounds. No new concentration-threshold conversion.
selection: For every source and frozen weight, choose minimum weighted target/change distance only from the fully checked pool, stable ties in saved pool order. If empty record failure. Keep old weight choices and old 11 paths as explicit comparisons; do not relax constraints to force success. Pareto status only within this finite checked pool.
refit_scope: Paired within-style beer bootstrap of the fixed R2 ET parameters, no retuning, on the original eleven frozen before/after paths only. Each sampled beer occurrence has unit total rating weight with original within-beer taster weights. Refit imputation on resampled beer occurrences, not expanded rating records. Evaluate raw grades and uncalibrated ET rating probabilities; do not attach the original sigmoid calibration to new forests. No path reselection. Reuse original 200-refit old-guard evidence in separate columns.
status: Every passed candidate remains an unvalidated model scenario; Stale historical probability support is insufficient and R3 five-defect median attribution is weak. No causal effects, post-transfer nonworsening, authentic style, or physical feasibility certified.
